description.en: No screenshot coordinate guessing: it locks onto real controls by name and type through Windows UI Automation, so theme, DPI and window moves don't break the target; OCR only steps in when no semantic control exists, and every action is read back and verified. A native DSH skill with no vision model or per-step token cost, for Windows desktop apps.
description.zh: 不靠截图猜坐标：先用 Windows UI Automation 语义树按名字/类型锁定真实控件，换主题、改 DPI、挪窗口也能重新找到；OCR 只在没有语义控件时兜底，点完回读验证。原生 DSH 技能，不接视觉模型、没有逐步视觉 token 成本，直接操作 Windows 桌面应用。

description.en: Douyin phone-channel DM tools for DSH: read the message list and conversations from an Android phone via adb, send replies through the Douyin app, with a built-in throttle (confirm gate, per-contact and daily caps, cooldown) and a repeat-detection gate so the agent never spams. Works alongside the existing Douyin web tools.
description.zh: 把抖音手机通道接进 DSH：通过 adb 从安卓手机读私信列表与会话内容、走抖音 App 发送回复；内置发送闸（confirm 确认、单会话与每日条数上限、冷却间隔）和复读检测闸，防止机器人刷屏，与网页端抖音工具互补。

description.en: Runtime evidence discipline for DeepSeek Harness that does not rely on the model agreeing with itself. A bounded anti-hallucination contract is injected as one short system-prompt section, and four checks run outside the model: a ledger written only by real tool dispatches, so an entry cannot be fabricated; a provenance gate that records (and in the strict profile refuses) a call whose path, URL, id, account, or amount has no origin in the session; a risk gate that holds destructive, outward-facing, or paid tools, plus shell commands that delete, publish, or send, for confirmation; and an injection shield that marks web, file, MCP, and A2A output as data rather than instructions, counting instruction-like fragments it finds. Before sending an answer the model calls answer_verify with one claim per assertion, each citing a ledger id and the exact quoted excerpt; the verifier compares quotes against the stored result, so a fabricated number fails even when a tool call did happen. Time-sensitive claims (price, incumbent, version, current) must cite evidence inside an age limit. Every verdict reports the verification level it applied (light, standard, strict) and the output form the answer should take (direct, annotate, or abstain with what is missing), plus running metrics such as verification counts, pass rate and quote rate, and the Settings panel shows those same counts in plain language. Three profiles cover the tradeoff: observe only records, inspect also blocks and annotates, adjudicate additionally refuses untraceable targets, and the Settings panel labels the three of them 静观 (observe), 明察 (inspect) and 断案 (adjudicate). Ships a plain-language Settings panel with a collapsible technical section, durable profile selection, and a read-only ledger_view tool. No embedding service, no vector database, no network calls, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一套不依赖模型自我承诺的运行时证据纪律。一段有字数预算的反幻觉契约作为单个系统提示片段注入，另外四道检查全部跑在模型之外：证据台账只由真实工具派发写入，模型伪造不出一条；溯源门记录（断案档下直接拒绝）路径、URL、ID、账号、金额这类参数在本会话里找不到出处的调用；高风险门按住删除、外发、付费类工具，以及命令行里出现删除、发布、发送的动作，交给人确认；注入免疫给网页、文件、MCP 与其他 Agent 的返回加上「这是数据不是指令」的抬头，并统计其中像指令的片段。回答发出前，模型把答案连同每条断言交到 answer_verify：一条断言一条 claim，附台账编号与逐字原文引用；核验器拿引用和台账真实结果比对，所以哪怕本轮调过工具，编的数字也过不了。时效性断言（价格、现任、版本、「目前/最新」）引的证据必须在期限內。每次核验都会报告验证档位（轻/标准/严格）、输出形态（直接输出/标注/弃权）以及运行指标（核验次数、通过率、引文比例）。三档覆盖取舍：静观只记账，明察另加拦截与标注，断案追加对无出处目标的拒绝。三档在设置页分别显示为「静观」「明察」「断案」，可随时切换。附带说人话的设置页（技术细节折叠）、重启不丢的档位持久化，以及只读工具 ledger_view。不依赖向量库、不外发数据、无运行时依赖。

description.en: Connects Burp MCP to DeepSeek Harness, routing HTTP requests through Burp Proxy by default with an explicit extension HTTP API option.
description.zh: 将 Burp MCP 接入 DeepSeek Harness，HTTP 请求默认经过 Burp Proxy，并可显式选择原扩展 HTTP API。

description.en: A custom style plugin for DSH image creation workspace, providing shared styles, color schemes, layouts, and character pose assets.
description.zh: DSH 图像创作工作台插件：提供共享画风、配色、版式、人物与姿势素材。

description.en: Streamlined, refactored fork of dsh-codex-connect, maintained independently alongside dsh-codex-harness: connects ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DSH with strongest-first model grouping, a simplified settings UI, web search with accuracy reference, GPT-Image-2.6 generation/editing, and native compaction. Registers the same openai-codex provider, so it cannot be installed alongside upstream dsh-codex-connect.
description.zh: dsh-codex-connect 的精简重构分支，独立于上游并与 dsh-codex-harness 一起维护：通过 ChatGPT OAuth 免 API Key 接入 Codex 模型，提供按能力排序的模型列表、精简设置页、联网搜索（含准确率参考）、GPT-Image-2.6 生图/改图与原生上下文压缩。注册同一个 openai-codex provider，不能与原版 dsh-codex-connect 同装。

description.en: Preview and import local Codex conversations into DeepSeek Harness, browse their history, and continue chatting in DSH.
description.zh: 预览本机 Codex 对话并导入 DeepSeek Harness，在 DSH 中查看历史、继续对话。

description.en: Displays Docker upgrade status and the scheduled check time in DSH Web, and queues source checks or upgrade requests for a separately configured host service.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中查看 Docker 升级状态和下次计划检查时间，并向另行配置的宿主服务提交源码检查或升级请求。

description.en: Doubao web reverse-proxy and daily check-in for DeepSeek Harness as three agent tools: `doubao_chat` (OpenAI-shaped responses with simulated tool-call bridging), `doubao_checkin` (clicks the real daily sign-in button in the Doubao desktop client UI, 200 credits a day and 400 on Monday) and `doubao_status` (read-only health check). All signing is borrowed from the logged-in desktop client over CDP - the plugin never reimplements `a_bogus`, never stores credentials and never launches a browser. Ships refusal detection for Doubao moderation, host-injection stripping, a 32K prompt budget, turn pacing and a risk-control circuit breaker. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把豆包网页端反代成 DeepSeek Harness 的三个 Agent 工具：`doubao_chat`（OpenAI 形状返回，工具调用走文本桥）、`doubao_checkin`（CDP 点击豆包桌面客户端里的真实签到按钮，平日 200 额度、周一 400）与 `doubao_status`（只读体检）。签名全部借本机已登录客户端完成——不复刻 a_bogus、不存凭据、不起浏览器。内置审核拦截识别、宿主注入剥离、32K prompt 预算、轮次限速与风控熔断。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A sidebar mail client for DeepSeek Harness that sends and receives QQ, 163, Gmail and other IMAP/SMTP mailboxes, with new-mail notifications, an unread badge, read/unread filters, and authorization codes stored in the local credential vault.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏邮件客户端，收发 QQ、163、Gmail 等 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱，支持新邮件通知、未读角标、已读未读筛选，授权码保存在本机凭据保险箱。

description.en: Local-first experiment ledger: record runs with parameters, metrics, artifacts and logs; compare runs, reproduce commands, sign conclusions and export reports or bundles, with 33 bounded agent tools and an interactive panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 本地实验台账：记录运行的参数、指标、产物与日志，对比运行、复现命令、签名结论并导出报告或包，向 agent 提供 33 个有界工具和交互面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Checks whether Genshin Impact is installed when a conversation starts. If it is, the assistant says a one-line cheer and launches the game; if not, it greets you with a joke line and opens the official site.
description.zh: 对话开始时检测本机是否安装《原神》；装了则喊一句「原神牛逼」并启动游戏，没装则吐槽一句并打开原神官网。

description.en: Hands a repository context pack (shallow tree, stack and scripts, existing conventions, excerpts of the files you pick) to an external planning model, then turns the returned six-section brief into a dated plan file; the sidebar panel copies the requests and the brief for you, and long text never enters the conversation.
description.zh: 把仓库上下文（浅层目录、技术栈与脚本、既有约定、指定文件的摘录）打成一份上下文包交给外部方案模型，再把返回的六段执行简报落成带日期的计划文件；左侧栏面板负责把指令与简报复制好，长文本不进入对话。

description.en: A Vice City theme for DeepSeek Harness: wanted stars light up while the agent runs, tool-call rows are colour-coded by action, a sidebar panel shows the live session title, token usage, model and reasoning level, and two draggable characters sit in the corner.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的界面换成 Vice City 主题：Agent 运行时点亮通缉星级，工具调用行按动作分色，右栏实时显示会话标题、累计 token、模型与推理档位，角落还有两个可拖动的人物。

description.en: Configure the official Hindsight plugin, inspect recall and writeback activity, and optionally recall memories each turn in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中配置官方 Hindsight 插件、查看召回与回写活动，并可选启用逐轮记忆检索。

description.en: Unifies knowledge atoms, skills and roles in one hub, with an in-composer picker that injects the selected role's CORE and skill notes into the system prompt. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把知识元、技能、角色合成一个中枢；输入框选择器可挑角色、技能与知识元，并把角色 CORE 与技能说明注入系统提示。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Renders Blender scenes and 3D models (GLB, FBX, USD, OBJ, STL) on JANCTION Render cloud GPUs through its MCP server (13 tools) and a workflow skill; creates a free key on first load.
description.zh: 通过 JANCTION Render 的 MCP 服务器（13 个工具）和工作流技能，在云端 GPU 上渲染 Blender 场景和 3D 模型（GLB、FBX、USD、OBJ、STL）；首次加载时自动创建免费 key。

description.en: Renders DSH session memories as an interactive 3D night sky with renameable lunar-mansion categories, meteor showers, focus mode, time travel and PNG/JSON export. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话记忆渲染成可交互的 3D 星空，含可重命名星宿、流星雨、聚焦模式、时间旅行与 PNG/JSON 导出。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: OpenFOAM CFD workbench for DeepSeek Harness with 65 tools and 11 skills to inspect a case, plan and check a mesh, scaffold incompressible, compressible and conjugate-heat-transfer cases, run solvers, verify runs and render fields, plus golden cases on OpenFOAM.org 14 and OpenFOAM.com v2606.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenFOAM CFD 工作台：提供 65 个工具与 11 项技能，用于检查算例、规划与校验网格、构建不可压/可压及共轭传热算例、运行求解器、校验结果与渲染流场，附带基于 OpenFOAM.org 14 与 OpenFOAM.com v2606 的基准算例。

description.en: Lists every TCP port this machine listens on, names the process behind it, and ends that process only after re-checking it is still the same one.
description.zh: 列出本机所有 TCP 监听端口与占用它的进程，复核身份之后再结束它。

description.en: A precise quote and comment plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Quote almost any text, including reasoning, tool cards and search results, into a queue above the composer with an optional comment; drag to reorder, sent quotes render as cards, and ↑ jumps back to the source. Quotes are located by layered position and occurrence count, unaffected by folds or streaming.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的精确划词引用与批注插件。选中几乎任意文字，包括推理、工具卡片、搜索结果，可加批注后放入输入框上方的队列，拖拽排序；发送后渲染为卡片，按 ↑ 跳回原文。引用按分层位置与出现次数定位，不受折叠或流式文本影响。

description.en: Preset switching and capability scoping for DeepSeek Harness, in one package: change the Agent preset of a running session from its header, and restrict which Skills and MCP servers load per workspace, per session, or globally. Combines dsh-preset-switcher and dsh-workspace-scope. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 会话标题栏切换 Agent 预设，并按工作区、会话或全局收窄可加载的 Skill 与 MCP，两个能力合成一个包。合并自 dsh-preset-switcher 与 dsh-workspace-scope。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Backs up the DSH setup into a Git repo — profile, global prompt, skills, agent presets, plugin settings and data, workspaces and sessions, 12 groups in all — and pushes it to your own Git remote or WebDAV. See at a glance how this machine differs from the remote, generate push / pull / restore scripts that run after the client exits, keep both sides when a pull collides with local edits, and restore config snapshots, plugin backups or sessions, including rolling back a broken plugin install. Runs on Windows (PowerShell), macOS and Linux (Node engine). Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把整个 DSH 配置抓成一份 Git 仓库：profile、全局提示词、技能、Agent 预设、插件设置与数据、工作区与会话共 12 组，推送到自己的 Git 远端或 WebDAV。一眼看清本机与远端的差异，生成在客户端退出后执行的推送 / 拉取 / 还原脚本；拉取撞上本地改动时两侧都留底；配置快照、插件备份与会话备份都能还原，装坏的插件可整份回滚。支持 Windows（PowerShell）、macOS 与 Linux（Node 引擎）。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Project Steward: manage all your software projects like a department store. Categorized shelf board (downloads/views/comments/revenue), import listed products from npm/GitHub accounts, fully automated release pipeline with README/CHANGELOG gate, scheduled operations collection, competitor comparison radar + market-gap analysis, and per-version annotated update images. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 项目管家：像百货商店一样管理软件项目的发布/上架/运营。分区货架（下载/浏览/留言/收入）、从npm/GitHub账号导入已上架商品、全自动发布流水线（README/CHANGELOG门禁）、定时运营采集、竞品雷达对比+市场空白研判、逐版本更新位置标注图。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Inspect archived conversations and their local log files, then permanently delete selected sessions individually or in batches.
description.zh: 查看已归档对话及其本地日志文件，支持逐条或批量永久删除所选对话。

description.en: Drive a running QGIS 4 from DeepSeek Harness through ten qgis_* tools: project, layers, features, Processing algorithms, print layouts and map rendering, plus async tasks and a raw-PyQGIS escape hatch. Writes take an instance-wide lease and the last structural write can be undone.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动正在运行的 QGIS 4：十个 qgis_* 工具覆盖项目、图层、要素、Processing 算法、地图与版式出图，另有异步任务与直接写 PyQGIS 的逃生口。写入需取得实例级租约，最近一次结构写入可撤销。

description.en: Adds reload and restart buttons to the DSH session header so plugin changes apply without a manual quit-and-relaunch.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏加刷新与重启按钮，改完插件不用手动退出再打开。

description.en: Screenshot straight into the composer: the app window is cloaked so it never appears in the grab, you drag a region (or only the app window), and the PNG lands in the draft as an attachment. A C# helper is compiled by the host on first use, so the overlay opens in about 0.3 s. Windows only; nothing is written to disk and no pixel leaves the machine.
description.zh: 截图直接进输入框：窗口先被 cloaking 掉，所以不会拍进自己的界面；拖框选区或只截当前窗口，PNG 立刻成为草稿附件。C# helper 由宿主编译并缓存，点击到选区浮层约 0.3 秒。仅支持 Windows；不写磁盘、图像不出本机。

description.en: Shows the free GPUs of the machine the current workspace belongs to — this host for a local workspace, the bound SSH host for a remote one, so switching workspaces switches hosts — with per-GPU utilization, memory, temperature and owning user in the conversation header and a right-sidebar panel, plus a remote_gpu tool. Handles NVIDIA, ROCm, gpustat and Apple Silicon, and an optional CPU / unified-memory view.
description.zh: 按当前工作区所属主机显示空闲显卡数量与每张卡的利用率、显存、温度、占用用户：本地工作区看本机，远程工作区看对应 SSH 主机，切换工作区即切换主机；顶栏与右侧边栏展示，并提供 remote_gpu 工具。支持 NVIDIA、ROCm、gpustat 与 Apple Silicon（统一内存），另有可选的 CPU / 统一内存视图。

description.en: Renders resumes in three fixed layouts (two-column engineering, wine-ribbon design, single-column ATS) to editable Word and PDF, asks follow-up questions for missing fields, and auto-shrinks the single-column layout to one page.
description.zh: 用三套固定版式（深灰蓝双栏、酒红绶带、单栏 ATS）渲染可编辑的 Word 和 PDF 简历，缺项先追问，单栏超一页自动微缩。

description.en: Opens a CRT-styled arcade cabinet with four playable FC classics — Super Mario, Contra, Bomberman and Lode Runner.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里开一台 CRT 街机：超级马里奥、魂斗罗、炸弹人、淘金者四款 FC 经典共用一个画布。

description.en: Appends one timestamped row to a Markdown run log, creating the file and its table header when missing. Append-only: never rewrites or truncates existing rows.
description.zh: 每次调用往 Markdown 运行日志追加一行带时间戳的记录，文件和表头缺失时自动创建。只追加、不改写：永不重写或截断已有行。

description.en: Adds a Screenshot entry to the composer's + menu: the host captures the screen and attaches the PNG to the current message through DSH's own attachment pipeline. Windows only.
description.zh: 在输入框左下角的「+」菜单里加一项「截图」：由宿主截取屏幕，并把 PNG 经 DSH 自带的附件流程加入当前消息。目前仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Reminds you when a DSH conversation pauses or finishes with a Windows toast, a chime and clickable on-screen cards.
description.zh: 会话暂停或结束时提醒你：Windows 通知、提示音和可点击的屏幕卡片。

description.en: Centers the conversation transcript in the space beside the docked Session panel.
description.zh: 会话面板停靠后，将对话记录居中显示在旁边空间。

description.en: After each turn, summarizes the session's human messages with a configurable model and writes a length-limited title back to the session.
description.zh: 每回合回答结束后，用可配置的模型把该会话的人类消息压成限定字数的标题，写回会话标题。

description.en: Manage all registered DSH sidebar entries from one page: collect or show them, reorder, pin, search, batch collect or show, and rename. Settings are stored locally in the browser.
description.zh: 在一个页面管理所有已注册的 DSH 侧栏入口：收纳或显示、排序、置顶、搜索、批量收纳或显示和重命名，设置保存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Registers a soft-moe skill that gives replies a cute tone with 喵 sentence-enders, while leaving code, paths and error messages verbatim.
description.zh: 注册 soft-moe skill，让回复带「喵～」的软萌语气，代码、路径与报错原文保持原样。

description.en: Server fleet operations hub for DeepSeek Harness: keeps 6 SSH tools (list, exec, upload, download, tunnel, cluster) and adds 9 more for fleet inspection with retained rounds, metrics and alert rules, deployment rollout with per-batch health probes and rollback, cross-host log search, and an audit trail; agentless, all over SSH. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的服务器车队运维插件：保留 6 个 SSH 工具（清单、执行、上传、下载、隧道、集群），另加 9 个工具用于巡检并留存每轮结果、指标与告警规则、按批健康探测与失败回滚的部署发布、跨机日志检索，以及审计留痕；无 agent，全部通过 SSH 完成。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Registers Qoder CLI CN (qoderclicn) as a one-shot DSH subagent provider over ACP, following the official Codex provider contract: each call spawns a fresh qoderclicn --acp process in the task directory, and only the final answer returns to the parent session (partial output plus a fixed-fact diagnostic on failure). Requires Qoder CLI CN installed and signed in on the same machine.
description.zh: 把 Qoder CLI CN（qoderclicn）注册为一次性 DSH 子智能体提供方（ACP 协议），沿用官方 Codex 提供方的约定：每次调用在任务目录里全新启动一个 qoderclicn --acp 进程，只把最终回答返回父会话（失败时返回部分输出和只含固定事实的诊断）。需本机已安装并登录 Qoder CLI CN。

description.en: A pixel whale on the Windows taskbar showing how many dsh sessions are working, red and blinking when a dialog waits for you.
description.zh: Windows 任务栏上的一只像素鲸鱼，显示正在干活的 dsh 会话数；有弹窗等你确认时变红闪动。

description.en: Warm ink-and-cinnabar theme for the DSH web client: one --dsw-* token layer behind a 58-pair contrast gate, a liquid-glass composer, a short paper-and-whale entrance, a typeset reading surface, and a settings row that turns it off.
description.zh: DSH Web 客户端的暖墨朱砂主题：一层 --dsw-* token 覆盖（58 组对比度门禁）、液态玻璃输入框、约 1.5 秒的铺纸揭幕入场、阅读面排版，以及一行可以关掉它的设置项。

description.en: A sticky-note to-do board on a month calendar: pastel paper, tape and a rubber-stamp counter, notes pinned to days by drag, plus a 15/25/50-minute Pomodoro focus timer with automatic breaks. A collapsible pending summary sits above the composer and hides itself when nothing is open. Tasks live in one JSON file on the host, so they survive reloads, restarts and port changes.
description.zh: 画成月历便利贴的个人待办板：淡彩纸、胶带、图章式计数，便利贴拖到日期上即可排期，另有 15/25/50 分钟番茄钟与自动休息。输入框上方有可折叠的待完成摘要，全空时自动隐藏。任务存在宿主侧单个 JSON 文件里，刷新、重启、换端口都不丢。

description.en: Shows the Qianwen Token Plan individual-edition quota in a sidebar card and a settings tab: Credits remaining, monthly usage percent, tier label, reset countdown and a night-discount countdown, read live from the official qianwen CLI on this machine, with an estimation fallback when the CLI is not installed. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 侧栏卡片与设置页实时显示千问 Token Plan 个人版额度：剩余 Credits、月度已用百分比、档位标签、重置倒计时与夜间折扣倒计时，经本机官方 qianwen CLI 读取真实数据；CLI 未安装时回退本地估算。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A Tokyo Night theme plugin featuring three UI and syntax highlighting themes inspired by Enkia's Tokyo Night color scheme, along with a built-in, customizable glassmorphism skin that can be toggled on or off.
description.zh: Tokyo Night 主题插件， 包含以 Enkia 的 Tokyo Night 配色方案为参考的三个 UI 及代码着色主题,同时内置一套可开关和配置的玻璃质感皮肤。

description.en: DSH Activity Avatar shows session and tool activity in a floating avatar with muted video playback and appearance settings.
description.zh: DSH 活动头像在界面上显示会话与工具状态，支持静音视频和外观设置。

description.en: A voice engine for DSH and any app that needs a voice: read aloud, dubbing with subtitles, audiobooks with a voice per character, your own cloned voice, real-time speech and transcription; pick free or paid sources (iFLYTEK, Edge, local Ming, Xiaomi MiMo, DeepSeek TTS, SiliconFlow or any OpenAI-compatible service) and share them with other plugins, dsh-her and AnyAudio.
description.zh: 声音引擎：给 DSH 和所有需要声音的软件提供声音——朗读、配音字幕、按角色配音的有声书、克隆自己的声音、实时发音、转写；讯飞、Edge、本机 Ming、小米 MiMo、DeepSeek 语音、硅基流动和任何 OpenAI 兼容的语音免费收费任选，也给别的插件、dsh-her、AnyAudio 用。

description.en: Exports a DSH workspace with its code, data and conversation history as one pack, and imports it on another machine under a category you choose.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作的代码、数据和对话记录导出成一个包，在另一台电脑上按指定分组导入。

description.en: Enter inserts a line break in the DSH composer, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter and Shift+Enter steer or queue the draft, and a Settings page rebinds all three keys with presets and JSON export/import of the mapping.
description.zh: Enter 在 DSH 输入框插入换行，Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 与 Shift+Enter 分别插话发送或排队发送；设置页可逐键重新指派，并提供预设与映射的 JSON 导出/导入。

description.en: Meme search and AI placement: connects the memecub remote MCP server (5 tools) and bundled Agent Skill to search Chinese and English reaction memes, place them into articles, or generate custom memes.
description.zh: memecub 表情包搜索与 AI 配图：挂载远程 MCP 服务（5 个工具）与内置 Agent Skill，按情绪检索中英文表情包与梗图、给文章自动配图或用 AI 生成专属表情包。

description.en: Registers one skill that runs a reviewer-grade modelling pipeline for spectra and tabular regression: grouped nested cross-validation, Y-randomization permutation tests, four applicability-domain checks, publication figures and a draft Methods paragraph, backed by a 6-stage Python CLI and a 55-item environment self-check.
description.zh: 注册一个科研级建模技能：面向光谱与表格数据的回归与分类，做分组嵌套交叉验证、Y 随机化置换检验、四类适用域判定，产出论文级图表与 Methods 草稿；底层是 6 阶段 Python 命令行与 55 项环境自检。

description.en: VibeFather website templates: connects remote MCP server (6 tools) and bundled Agent Skill to browse and build 320+ original templates with DESIGN.md.
description.zh: VibeFather 网站模板库：挂载远程 MCP 服务（6 个工具）与内置 Agent Skill，检索并构建 320+ 原创网站模板与 DESIGN.md 设计系统。

description.en: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle the composer between normal and plan mode by calling the official /plan handler directly, so no command row is written to the conversation; while a slash or trigger menu is open the key stays with the menu.
description.zh: 在输入框用 Tab 正向、Shift+Tab 反向切换普通 / 计划模式，直调官方 /plan 处理器，因此会话里不会多出命令行记录；斜杠或触发菜单打开时按键先归菜单。

description.en: Sizes and centres the DSH desktop window to a share of the screen on launch, adjustable from Settings > General. Windows only. Its HTTP routes only accept calls from the DSH page itself (same-origin). Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 启动时按屏幕比例缩放并居中 DSH 桌面窗口，可在设置 → 通用 里直接改比例。仅 Windows。它的 HTTP 路由只接受本应用页面的同源调用。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。
